resolution.rationale: Goals stay AIR-only upstream in v0.99.0 and there is still no provider-neutral opt-in, so the patch is not absorbed. The v0.99.0 src/acp-agent.ts edits are: ACP error codes for unknown sessions and invalid config values (#1458), MCP server startup notices (#1464), a deny for a cancelled background permission request (#1466), embedded blob resources in prompts (#1460), the elicitation cancel/decline split (#1465), the current model listed among the model config values (#1463), the AskUserQuestion unanswered capability from the SDK 0.3.312 bump (#1471), CLAUDE_CODE_THINKING_DISPLAY (#1081) and the ACP v2 publishCurrentSessionInfo hook for session/resume (#1462). None of them reads or advertises the goal capability, calls goalMeta or the GOAL_* constants, or touches a goal call site; v0.99.0 does not change src/goal-extension.ts or docs/air-extensions.md. The candidate replays it onto the exact v0.99.0 tag with an unchanged stable patch-id, so its added, removed and context lines are identical to the ledger commit. (650615ee). The goal tests and the full suite pass on the integration.

resolution.rationale: Upstream v0.99.0 has no _alas/context_usage request and no contextUsage advertisement, so the patch is not absorbed. The SDK bump to @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.312 (#1471) keeps Query.getContextUsage({ detail }) and the build type-checks the handler against it. #1458 moves upstream's own unknown-session errors to RequestError.sessionNotFound; the extension handler keeps RequestError.resourceNotFound(sessionId), which in @agentclientprotocol/sdk 2.1.0 has the same JSON-RPC code -32002 and differs only in message and data (uri instead of sessionId). The shipped Alas contract therefore stays unchanged, and aligning the data key is left to a separate downstream change rather than a sync. The v0.99.0 src/acp-agent.ts edits are: ACP error codes for unknown sessions and invalid config values (#1458), MCP server startup notices (#1464), a deny for a cancelled background permission request (#1466), embedded blob resources in prompts (#1460), the elicitation cancel/decline split (#1465), the current model listed among the model config values (#1463), the AskUserQuestion unanswered capability from the SDK 0.3.312 bump (#1471), CLAUDE_CODE_THINKING_DISPLAY (#1081) and the ACP v2 publishCurrentSessionInfo hook for session/resume (#1462). None touches the request handler or the initialize _meta.contextUsage entry. The candidate replays it onto the exact v0.99.0 tag with an unchanged stable patch-id, so its added, removed and context lines are identical to the ledger commit. (1ddb0ffe).
